evidence: Applied the skill's procedure for check 5 to the full public brief (task/instruction.md, environment/instructions/hireops_rules.md, environment/instructions/integration.md). (1) Case-insensitive grep for judge|rubric|criteri|dimension|reward|weight|score|playwright|claude|glm|/tests|sentinel|gate|probe|grader|grading|verif|functional|polish|visual|oracle|harbor|likert|points|pass|fail returned only benign hits: the password 'Hireops!2026' (instruction.md:17, hireops_rules.md:11, matched via 'password') and 'If any card fails, none of them moves' (hireops_rules.md:92, a product rule). A second grep for restart_app|replay|mcp|independent context|hro_|binary|APP_RESTART|/logs|reward returned nothing (rc=1). No CHANGE_ME/TODO/template placeholders. (2) All 55 criterion ids (hro_*, including hro_gate_render/hro_gate_shared and hro_vis_*/hro_pol_*) and every UPPER-CASE hyphenated token in tests/** were checked against the public text: none appears. No dimension names (functional/polish/visual), weights, test paths (/tests, tools/score.py, restart_mcp.py) or judge identity are named. (3) 10-word sliding-window verbatim overlap between public files and all tests/** toml/md found exactly one run: 'arrive at the bottom of that stage in board order' (hireops_rules.md:90 vs functional/judge.toml:209, hro_bulk_move). That is the criterion restating a public product rule, not grader text leaking into the brief; the brief does not reveal the test's scenario (Y, W, X / A2, V). (4) Probe literals in functional/prompt.md (suffixed J1/J2 jobs, A-F/V-Z cards, the seeded note 'Strong systems answers; weaker on incident follow-up.', the seeded Platform Engineer order) are not named in the brief. The brief's activity example 'Mei Lin moved Priya Nair from Screen to Interview' (hireops_rules.md:111) uses seeded people as an illustrative wording example; no criterion requires that exact line. The account list in instruction.md:17 duplicates tests/app_context.md, but those are product sign-in facts the brief must state (check 4/52 territory and a documented known false positive), not grader machinery. The 15-second, 30-message and interview-place numbers are public product requirements. Weak-app/alternative probe: a model that reads only the brief learns nothing about the judge or its probes that would let a broken app game scoring, and a conforming app is not penalised by anything here. Scope: this is a source check; I did not run the private check-instruction-hygiene.py executable, and no runtime evidence is needed for this row.
